encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

ἔχων φιάλιον τῷδε. Β. πολλὰ γίνεται

div.note: Athenaeus 11, 467 bc μνημονεύει δὲ τοῦ γραμματικοῦ ἐκπώματος ὡς οὕτως καλουμένου Εὔβουλος ἐν Νεοττίδι οὕτως κτλ.

1. κάκιστα Dobr. Adv. II 330 conl. Arist. Ran. 1456] κάκιστον A. ἔκπωμ’ Iacobs. Addit. Ath. 250] ἔκπωμα ει A. 2. αταρως ὁμοιον ουμὸς υἱὸς ᾤχετ’ A. 3. φιάλιον τῷδε. Β. πολλά Cobet. N. 1. 20] φιάλιον· τῷ δὲ πολλά. ‘pater ἀτὰρ — τῷδε, deinde alius nascentem suspicionem avertens aut elevans respondet πολλὰ κτλ.’ Cobet. necessarium videtur sic verba distribuere: A. μισῶ — ἀεί. B. ἀτὰρ — τῷδε. A. πολλὰ κτλ. Plaut. Rudent. 478 haec (urna) litterata est: eapse cantat quoia sit.
